collectionActions.egg: After placing the Kronorium on Kino’s podium, find an egg, take it to an acid-pool incubator inside the Apothicon and supply its souls yourself. Carry the hatched gateworm to hunt a rune.
collectionActions.rune: Carry a gateworm. Follow its beeps and interact where they are fastest, then collect the revealed rune. One rune is recovered in each region.
collectionActions.bone: Shoot the stone with a Pack-a-Punched bullet weapon to release a bone, then absorb the floating bone with the upgraded Apothicon Servant.
collectionActions.relic: After the four trial arenas, throw the Summoning Key at the target. A successful hit gives an audio/visual cue. Retrieve the key before moving on.

plantPlanter.alt: An ordinary circular stone planter with a grown pod. Find an empty ring like this to plant your seed.

flak.name: Anti-aircraft shell
flak.purpose: Main quest: load this shell into the artillery cannon to shoot down the plane and recover an elevator cog.
flak.needs: A seed, a bucket of blue water, and KT-4 or Masamune.
flak.result: Harvest for a chance at a flak shell. Grow several plants in parallel; another reward is possible.

fruit.name: Fruit / eat-a-fruit trial
fruit.purpose: Use this if your personal trial asks you to eat a fruit. Fruit can also give a bonus perk or make you vomit.
fruit.needs: A seed and a bucket. Visit each of the three coloured pools over three rounds.
fruit.result: Three different colours, in any order, give a chance of fruit. If another plant grows, start again with a new seed.

holder.name: Hold a zombie alive
holder.purpose: Optional: keep a zombie occupied while you work on other steps. Avoid shooting the zombie held by the plant.
holder.needs: A seed and a bucket of green water.
holder.result: A mature green plant can catch and hold a nearby zombie. Return to check on it while doing other steps.

killer.name: Killing plant
killer.purpose: Optional: grow a plant that attacks nearby zombies. Keep it away from the last zombie if you need to save the round.
killer.needs: A seed and a bucket of purple water.
killer.result: The mature purple plant attacks nearby zombies. Leave it in place to do its work.

imprint.name: Imprint / saved loadout
imprint.purpose: Optional: an imprint plant can save your current equipment and perks and restore that snapshot after you die.
imprint.needs: A seed, a bucket and KT-4 or Masamune. Blue is a simple repeatable route; green or purple water can also work.
imprint.result: An imprint is a chance reward. If one grows, interact with it to save your loadout before you need the revive.

masamune.name: Masamune quest plant
masamune.purpose: KT-4 upgrade: grow the underwater ingredient needed to build Masamune.
masamune.needs: A seed, a bucket and the Skull of Nan Sapwe. First Mesmerize the torn poster beside the purple pool, then the hidden wall in the deep underwater cave.
masamune.place: Secret planter behind that hidden wall, in the deepest cave where you found the original KT-4 plant. An ordinary planter will not grow this ingredient.
masamune.result: Harvest the quest ingredient on the fourth round from the revealed underwater planter.

link.label: KT-4, Masamune and the hidden planter

plantSupplies.name: A bucket
plantSupplies.instruction: Pick one up at spawn, either lab or the bunker. Hold interact at a water pool to fill it; check the colour in your inventory.

plantSupplies.name: A seed

image.alt: The spiky seed dropped by zombies.

plantSupplies.instruction: Kill zombies until one drops a seed, then collect it. At an empty circular stone planter, interact to plant the seed.

Blue.location: Behind Lab A · near the spider cave
directions: Go behind Lab A to the pool beside the webbed entrance to the giant spider cave.
With a bucket, hold interact at the pool. Check that the bucket icon turns blue.

images.alt: Blue water: the pool behind Lab A, beside the webbed cave entrance.

Green.location: Below Lab B · beside the sewer exit
directions: Look below and behind Lab B, close to where the sewer slide comes out. The pool sits under the wooden shelter.
Hold interact at the pool with your bucket. Check that the bucket icon turns green.

images.alt: Green water: the pool under the wooden shelter below Lab B.

Purple.location: Inside the bunker · spider cocoon room
directions: Enter the bunker and take the door to the right of the central Pack-a-Punch area into the room full of hanging cocoons.
Find the purple pool near the torn poster. Hold interact with your bucket and check its colour.

images.alt: Purple water: the glowing pool in the bunker’s spider cocoon room.

Rainbow.location: Sewer slide · lower bunker → Lab B
directions: Bring a bucket and 500 points to the sewer entrance near the KT-4 workbenches in the lower bunker, opposite Mule Kick.
Ride toward Lab B. Hold interact as you pass the glowing Element 115 rock on the right, circled in the photo. The collection window is brief.
Check that your bucket now shows Rainbow water. If it did not change, ride again and adjust your timing. An ordinary bucket works.

images.alt: Start at this sewer entrance in the lower bunker and travel toward Lab B.
Collect while passing the rock circled on the right. This is a timed pickup during the sewer ride.
